status: completed outcome-informed nested-geometry sensitivity; not independent validation or model selection
limitations: The two normalized C/S/M volume combinations are illustrative and not measured or statistically inferred.

The nested point-mean test assumes the whole model endolymph maps to the 3.05 uL chinchilla group mean and all C, S and M are disjoint subvolumes of whole stria; it is necessary under that mapping, not proof of anatomical validity.
C may include extrastrial structures; alternatively assigning all of it to stria is a restrictive illustrative case, not a measured compartment mapping.

The same normalized geometry is assumed for guinea pig and chinchilla, and basal concentrations and absolute normalized amount-flux and water-coefficient ranges are unchanged; scaling alternatives are not tested.
Fixed E volume requires an unspecified water source, and the original ungated water rate has no positivity proof.
The objective is not a likelihood, two prior-derived starts do not establish global optima, and fit or stability is not independent validation.
Branch spectra and finite perturbations are unforced fixed-inventory checks, not a global or switched-system stability proof.
Santi local swelling is not fitted; no bumetanide exposure model or independent prediction is provided.
The model remains electrically and chemically incomplete and K exchange is not an electrochemical or charge-complete flux.
